purpose: Cultural color palette specification board — Peking Opera color symbolism system
prompt:
Professional design specification board titled "文化色板 Cultural Palette" for a Peking Opera face paint guochao merchandise brand called 脸谱潮 LIANPU CHAO.

Layout: Clean grid on rice-paper #f5f0e8 background.

TOP SECTION — "京剧脸谱色彩象征体系" (Peking Opera Color Symbolism):
7 large color swatches in a horizontal row, each labeled with traditional Chinese color name and cultural meaning:
- 朱砂 Cinnabar #e8433f — 忠义 Loyalty (Guan Yu red face)
- 金箔 Gold Leaf #d4a843 — 神仙 Divine (Sun Wukong gold face)
- 墨色 Ink Black #1a1a2e — 刚直 Integrity (Bao Zheng black face)
- 宣纸 Rice Paper #f5f0e8 — 智谋 Wisdom (Cao Cao white face)
- 石青 Azurite #2d6a8e — 刚强 Fierce (Dou Erdun blue face)
- 藤黄 Gamboge #f0b32d — 勇武 Valor
- 石绿 Jade #3a8c6e — 顽强 Tenacious

MIDDLE SECTION — Color contrast pairs shown as bold flat blocks:
- Red + Gold (loyalty + divine)
- Black + White (integrity + wisdom)
- Blue + Yellow (fierce + valor)

BOTTOM SECTION — Small opera mask silhouette thumbnails in each color showing which character each color represents, with thick outline strokes in guochao illustration style.

Style: Flat color blocks only, no gradients. Thick bold outlines (3-6px). Guochao street art energy. Professional design board layout with clear hierarchy. Ink-black #1a1a2e text on rice-paper #f5f0e8 background. Brand name 脸谱潮 in corner.
